purpose: Teach: 迷宮/生業/生身/ディテール/恐怖症/遺書/言い渡し/私事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、原因が迷宮入りしないよう、苦情の追跡を徹底しろ
lines.en: Make sure we track every complaint thoroughly. We can't let the causes slip into mystery.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clipped pace on the opening command. Weight on 「徹底しろ」 — not sharp, but unmissable. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when systems fail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。介護を生業とする方々の支援サービスを展開します
lines.en: Understood. We'll expand support services for those in the care work industry.
lines.style: Crisp, professional acknowledgment. Slight forward lean in the posture. Rapid-fire delivery of the plan — showing he's already thinking through implementation. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、デモも生身の社員に過度な負担を強いるな
lines.en: And don't put our staff through excessive strain for the sake of a demo. They're not props.
lines.style: Quieter intensity here. Lean back slightly — settling into something he cares about. The word 「過度な負担を強いるな」 carries weight without being loud. A line drawn.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品のディテール撮影に拘ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll be meticulous with the product detail shots.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Almost a note-to-self quality — he's already visualizing the work. No wasted words. Professional and inward at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の恐怖症対策にメンタルケア窓口を設けろ
lines.en: Set up a mental health support desk for the staff. Phobias, anxieties — people need a place to turn.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost gentle for a directive. Pause before 「メンタルケア窓口」 — he's thinking of actual people. Not bureaucracy. The tone shifts from commander to someone who understands the weight people carry.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の遺書、つまり遺訓を社員に伝えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the staff are reminded of the founder's legacy — his teachings, his principles.
lines.style: Steady, almost reverent. Slower pace on 「遺訓」 — treating the founder's words as something sacred, not just policy. Respectful weight in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、解雇の言い渡しは慎重におこなえ
lines.en: Handle terminations with care. These decisions need to be made thoughtfully, not hastily.
lines.style: Firm but measured. A pause before 「慎重に」 — the word itself lands like a warning and a trust. Eyes steady. This is non-negotiable kindness, not softness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の私事に関する情報は厳重に管理します
lines.en: Understood. Any information about our staff's personal circumstances stays strictly confidential.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet conviction. Final statement of the meeting — shorter, more declarative. Professional seal on a conversation about trust and responsibility.
